# Strategic Sales Executive, New Marketplace Partnerships at Levanta

- **Company:** Levanta
- **Location:** New York (Remote), Washington (Remote), California (Remote), Florida (Remote), Texas (Remote), Ohio (Remote), Utah (Remote), Michigan (Remote), Pennsylvania (Remote), Massachusetts (Remote), DC (Remote)
- **Department:** Sales
- **Published:** 2026-06-17

# Description

Levanta is the creator affiliate platform built for modern e-commerce. We connect brands, creators, publishers, and marketplaces through a single platform for creator discovery, activation, partnership management, payments, and cross-channel performance measurement. Through our Creator Marketplace and AI-powered Social Discovery, brands can access more than 90,000 vetted creators and millions more across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, building measurable creator partnerships across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and other retail channels.

Following our recent $22 million Series B, which brought our total funding to more than $43 million, we are investing further in our technology, our team, and our expansion across the retail ecosystem. We are building the infrastructure for Creator Commerce Media and creating more opportunities for brands to grow, creators to earn, and marketplaces to generate measurable demand.

We're looking for a hungry enterprise seller to own the full cycle of signing new retail marketplace partnerships. You'll be responsible for sourcing, developing, and closing multi-year platform deals with major retailers. This is a high-visibility role working directly with the founders, with a clear path to building and leading a team as the pipeline scales.

This role is focused exclusively on new logo acquisition. The ideal candidate thrives in the earliest stages of a deal cycle and has a track record of opening doors and closing business in markets where you're building awareness from the ground up.

**What You'll Do:**

- Own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through signed contract on new retail marketplace partnerships

- Work a mix of self-sourced pipeline and warm opportunities already in motion

- Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals across marketplace, affiliate/creator, and retail media teams at major retailers

- Develop a repeatable outbound motion targeting retail marketplace and ecommerce leadership

- Represent Levanta at industry conferences and events

- Partner with founders on deal structure, negotiation strategy, and commercial terms

- Feed market intelligence back into product and GTM strategy

**What We're Looking For:**

- 5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales with demonstrated ability to close complex, multi-stakeholder deals

- Background in retail media, marketplace technology, or ecommerce SaaS strongly preferred

- Experience in affiliate or creator marketing is a plus

- Comfortable selling to VP and C-suite buyers across business units

- Outbound hunter mentality with the patience and polish to work long-cycle enterprise deals

- Strong commercial instincts, you can build a business case, negotiate terms, and know when to push

- Startup-ready: you build the playbook, you don't wait for one

**A note about comp:**

- Competitive base with significant commission upside tied to closed marketplace partnerships. This is a role where top performers have outsized and uncapped commission upside.

What Levanta Offers:

- A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Open vacation and sick policy, take the time you need.

- Opportunity for professional growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding startup.

- A culture that values diversity, inclusion, and the impact of every team member on our success.

- Must have a permanent address in one of our hub states: California, Florida, New York, Ohio, Utah, Texas, Michigan, Washington, Colorado, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, or DC.

Job Application for Creator Acquisition and Content Coordinator at Levanta

# Creator Acquisition and Content Coordinator

New York (Remote), Washington (Remote), California (Remote), Florida (Remote), Texas (Remote), Ohio (Remote), Utah (Remote), Michigan (Remote), Pennsylvania (Remote), Massachusetts (Remote), DC (Remote)

Levanta is the leading affiliate marketing platform for marketplace sellers, helping Amazon, Shopify and Walmart brands unlock a scalable, cost-effective marketing channel through direct affiliate partnerships. With access to over 70,000 vetted publishers, influencers, affiliates, and media buyers in Levanta’s Creator Marketplace, sellers can drive high-quality external traffic to their stores, control commissions, improve organic search rankings, and benefit from referral kickbacks on sales generated by their affiliates.

We're looking for a Creator Acquisition and Content Coordinator to help scale Levanta's creator marketplace by identifying, recruiting, and activating creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and Pinterest.

This is a highly outbound, growth-focused role. Roughly forty percent of your time will be spent sourcing creators, personalizing outreach, managing sequences, and helping creators join and activate on the platform. The other sixty percent will focus on creator marketing through filming and editing social content, community engagement, and educational content that helps creators succeed.

Your primary mission is growth: recruiting new creators to Levanta at scale, with a particular focus on creators who can drive revenue across our expanding non-Amazon marketplaces: Walmart, Shopify brands (DTC), and upcoming marketplace partnerships. Amazon is already well-served; the biggest opportunity ahead of us is building deliberate creator supply in these newer channels. You'll spend a significant part of your time sourcing and reaching out to creators who are already promoting these brands and showing them how to earn more through Levanta.

You'll work closely with our GTM and automation systems, which handle much of the top-of-funnel volume, enriching leads, sequencing outreach, and managing routine replies. Your role is the human layer on top of that engine: personalizing outreach, handling the more nuanced conversations, and making sure the creators you bring in actually activate. Alongside acquisition, you'll help own Levanta's social presence and support the Creator Team's content and community efforts.

Creator Acquisition & Marketplace Growth

- Source and recruit creators across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and Pinterest, with an emphasis on those driving revenue in non-Amazon categories (Walmart, DTC stores, and upcoming marketplace partnerships)
- Identify creators already promoting these brands and other marketplaces, and run warm outreach showing them how to earn more through Levanta's higher commission rates
- Run targeted outreach campaigns by category and marketplace to fill creator-supply gaps where we have brand demand but thin coverage
- Personalize outreach messaging over email and social based on creator niche, audience size, marketplace focus, and content style
- Encourage existing Levanta creators to expand into new marketplaces, curating product lists and hooks tied to specific brands and campaigns
- Manage inbound and complex outreach replies that fall outside automated workflows, qualifying, answering questions, and moving creators toward sign-up and activation
- Follow up with interested creators, book meetings with our Creator Managers, and help ensure new creators reach their first post and first attributed sale

Outreach Operations & Automation

- Build and manage outreach sequences that drive sign-ups to the Levanta platform
- Partner with our GTM engineering function to feed the outreach engine, refine targeting, and build marketplace-specific outreach tracks (e.g., distinct messaging for Walmart vs. other marketplaces vs. DTC)
- Track outreach activity, response rates, and pipeline progress in our CRM, and share what's converting
- Collaborate with the Creator Team to test new outreach strategies and continuously improve messaging

Social Media, Content & Marketing

- Help manage and post content across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook on a consistent schedule
- Film, edit, and produce short-form video content and graphics tailored to each platform
- Engage daily with followers, responding to comments and DMs and building genuine community
- Create content around affiliate marketing that educates and inspires creators on how to grow their income through Levanta
- Monitor trends and adapt content strategies to stay relevant and grow reach
- Curate product lists tied to events, holidays, and seasonal campaigns (e.g., gift guides, back-to-school, Black Friday)
- Assist with creator-focused email newsletters, helping draft, organize, and schedule content

General

- Handle daily creator platform approvals
- Support the Creator Team with additional projects, campaigns, and initiatives as needed

What We're Looking For:

- 1-2+ years in a coordinator, SDR/sales, community, social, or creator role (relevant internship experience counts)
- Comfortable with outreach and prospecting, not afraid to send a cold DM or email, and diligent about following up
- Strong, warm written communication and a natural, engaging voice online — for both content and outreach
- Active on TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook; you know what performs and why
- Experience creating and editing short-form video content (CapCut, Reels, TikTok, etc.)
- Highly organized, able to manage an outreach pipeline and a content calendar simultaneously
- Comfortable working with CRMs, automation, and outreach tools — or genuinely eager to learn
- Genuinely interested in the creator economy, affiliate marketing, or e-commerce

What Levanta Offers:

- A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Open vacation and sick policy, take the time you need.
- Opportunity for professional growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding startup.
- A culture that values diversity, inclusion, and the impact of every team member on our success.
- Must have a permanent address in one of our hub states: California, Florida, New York, Ohio, Utah, Texas, Michigan, or Washington. 

## Apply for this job

## Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Levanta’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

Race & Ethnicity Definitions

As a government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA), we request this information in order to measure the effectiveness of the outreach and positive recruitment efforts we undertake pursuant to VEVRAA. Classification of protected categories is as follows: 

A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.

A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

# Manager, Business Development (China Based) at Levanta

- **Company:** Levanta
- **Location:** Shenzhen, China
- **Department:** Sales
- **Published:** 2026-04-29

# Description

Levanta is the creator affiliate platform built for modern e-commerce. We connect brands, creators, publishers, and marketplaces through a single platform for creator discovery, activation, partnership management, payments, and cross-channel performance measurement. Through our Creator Marketplace and AI-powered Social Discovery, brands can access more than 90,000 vetted creators and millions more across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, building measurable creator partnerships across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and other retail channels.

Following our recent $22 million Series B, which brought our total funding to more than $43 million, we are investing further in our technology, our team, and our expansion across the retail ecosystem. We are building the infrastructure for Creator Commerce Media and creating more opportunities for brands to grow, creators to earn, and marketplaces to generate measurable demand.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Develop and manage relationships with major cross-border platform sellers (Amazon/Walmart), brands, and channel partners.

- Define and execute sales strategies for seller partners, lead client presentations, and support sustainable business growth on the platform.

- Contribute to the formulation and review of business development strategies for the China market.

- Collaborate closely with marketing and operations teams to ensure seamless project execution and continuous performance optimization.

**Qualifications:**

- Minimum of 3 years of business development experience with a proven track record in enterprise sales and channel management; prior experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, or SaaS industries is preferred.

- Extensive experience driving enterprise sales growth through consultative selling techniques, with solid analytic expertise in revenue forecasting, business planning, and pricing.

- Solid understanding of affiliate marketing models, platforms, and best practices; in-depth knowledge of Amazon marketplace operations is highly desirable.

- Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to build and maintain trusted partnerships.

- Proficiency in establishing scalable sales processes, reporting, and performance monitoring tools (e.g., Hubspot)

- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias for action, agility to navigate complex organizations, and a collaborative nature that fosters high-impact partnerships.

- Bachelor’s degree or above; proficiency in English is required.

_request.systemPrompt: Today is 2026-09-10. You are verifying one qualification test for one specific company. Use only what the sources say. The most recent dated announcement of an event is the authority on the company's current state; older announcements are history; company profile pages (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, CB Insights, Tracxn) are secondary to the company's own pages and to dated news. Never confuse the company with a same-name company on a different website. Answer pass only when a source states the fact; fail only when a source contradicts the test; otherwise unclear. The evidence_quote must be copied verbatim from the cited source.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences: what the freshest relevant source says and how it decides the test.

evidence_quote.description: A verbatim sentence or fragment from the cited source that decides the verdict; empty if unclear.

evidence_url.description: The URL the quote comes from; empty if unclear.

evidence_date.description: The date of that source as shown on it (YYYY-MM-DD if known); empty if unknown.
